nodes.label: Windows named-pipe connection for gavin-mcp
nodes.rationale: Windows advertises a socket path while using a named pipe; preserving explicit pipe paths and imposing a two-second connect/probe budget prevents indefinite IPC hangs.

nodes.label: Scheduled task is a copy
nodes.rationale: Scheduling copies the task into a separate file and leaves the original untouched, so the board remains stable and changes do not need to synchronize back.

nodes.label: Typing into a session in a test means CR, not LF
nodes.norm_label: typing into a session in a test means cr, not lf
nodes.rationale: PTY input tests must submit Enter as carriage return; cmd.exe interprets LF as Ctrl-J, leaving a recovered interactive command unsubmitted.

nodes.label: An isolated daemon on macOS needs a short HOME
nodes.norm_label: an isolated daemon on macos needs a short home
nodes.rationale: Keep the temporary HOME short because the macOS daemon socket path is rooted under Library/Application Support and must fit the 103-byte limit; XDG_DATA_HOME does not shorten it.

nodes.label: A kimi hook runs under every gavin build
nodes.norm_label: a kimi hook runs under every gavin build
nodes.rationale: A global kimi hook must require GAVIN_SHELL_WRITES before invoking the gavin-mcp hook command, because older hosting daemons may point GAVIN_MCP to a binary without that subcommand.

nodes.label: The Companion's 44px floor replaces a flex item's own minimum
nodes.norm_label: the companion's 44px floor replaces a flex item's own minimum
nodes.rationale: Use flex-wrap and a content basis for button rows because phone.css min-width:44px !important replaces the flex item automatic minimum and labels otherwise overflow at large text sizes.

nodes.label: An enum's rename_all never reaches its fields
nodes.norm_label: an enum's rename_all never reaches its fields
nodes.rationale: Add rename_all_fields="camelCase" beside rename_all on Rust enums with struct variants; enum-level rename_all changes variants, not their fields, so tests must assert exact serde_json wire keys.

nodes.label: Outside Tauri the window label is main, which runs rails

nodes.rationale: Non-Tauri clients loading orchestration modules must supply their own window label because the fallback is main and plan fetch/refresh/push paths tick rails when runsRailsFor accepts that label.
